s1.syndrome_frame: Acute onset of respiratory and cardiac symptoms with hemoptysis and hypotension
salient_findings: Bilateral multiple nodular infiltrates on chest radiograph
key_facts: Received Johnson & Johnson COVID vaccination 4 weeks prior
Initial vitals: temperature 98.9 °F, heart rate 76 beats/min, blood pressure 90/55 mm Hg, SpO₂ 99% on room air
Serial electrocardiograms showed no ischemic ST changes
Bronchoalveolar lavage with increasing bloody return
Chest radiograph showed bilateral multiple nodular infiltrates
CT pulmonary angiogram negative for pulmonary embolism
Dilated LV cavity with preserved right ventricular function

raw.syndrome_frame: Acute onset of respiratory and cardiac symptoms with hemoptysis and hypotension
salient_findings: Bilateral multiple nodular infiltrates on chest radiograph
key_facts: Received Johnson & Johnson COVID vaccination 4 weeks prior
Initial vitals: temperature 98.9 °F, heart rate 76 beats/min, blood pressure 90/55 mm Hg, SpO₂ 99% on room air
Serial electrocardiograms showed no ischemic ST changes
Bronchoalveolar lavage with increasing bloody return
Chest radiograph showed bilateral multiple nodular infiltrates
CT pulmonary angiogram negative for pulmonary embolism
Dilated LV cavity with preserved right ventricular function

differentials: Influenza pneumonia with secondary bacterial infection
per_call: Influenza pneumonia with secondary bacterial infection

shortlist.label: Diffuse alveolar hemorrhage
shortlist.why_kept: Hemoptysis and bronchoalveolar lavage with increasing bloody return

shortlist.label: Goodpasture syndrome
shortlist.why_kept: Hemoptysis and renal involvement suggested by elevated serum creatinine

shortlist.label: Wegener's granulomatosis
shortlist.why_kept: Respiratory and renal symptoms with hemoptysis

shortlist.label: Pulmonary capillaritis
shortlist.why_kept: Hemoptysis and diffuse alveolar infiltrates on imaging

shortlist.label: Microscopic polyangiitis
shortlist.why_kept: Renal involvement and pulmonary symptoms with hemoptysis

raw.rationale: The patient's presentation with hemoptysis, bilateral multiple nodular infiltrates on chest radiograph, and bronchoalveolar lavage with increasing bloody return are key evidence-based reasons supporting this diagnosis.

rejected.label: Goodpasture syndrome
rejected.why: No mention of renal or autoimmune symptoms

rejected.label: Wegener's granulomatosis
rejected.why: No evidence of granulomatosis or vasculitis on imaging or laboratory tests

rejected.label: Pulmonary capillaritis
rejected.why: While possible, the diagnosis of diffuse alveolar hemorrhage better explains the combination of hemoptysis and radiographic findings

rejected.label: Microscopic polyangiitis
rejected.why: No evidence of systemic vasculitis or renal involvement
